title: Îles-coptère
specs: Discover the Îles de la Madeleine from the sky by helicopter
Commitment to environmental protection and biodiversity
Compensation of CO₂ emissions through local reforestation funding
blurb: Îles-Coptère offers helicopter flights over the Îles de la Madeleine, showcasing the landscape including cliffs, beaches, and coasts. The company is committed to environmental respect and biodiversity protection, calculating CO₂ emissions and reinvesting in local reforestation. Flights are designed to avoid disturbing local fauna and flora.
